design.authority_boundary: model output cannot create, alter, or authorize a sandbox binding
design.mismatch_behavior: fail closed with namespace/cgroup mismatch denial

limitations: Validation is in QEMU and does not constitute production multi-tenant deployment qualification.
The feature attests identity and denies mismatch; it does not create namespaces or cgroups on behalf of an agent.
Provider-specific hardware isolation and distributed worker identity remain separate gates.
